R1.evidence: Cold boot of gws-launch-date-prod-v1 via `docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f harbor-main-build.override.yaml up --build -d`: gateway reached Healthy, agent started. `docker pull ghcr.io/abundant-ai/gworkspace-service:prod-v1` => 'Image is up to date' (public, no creds, R1.5). Agent reaches gateway by name: `curl http://gworkspace:8080/health` => {"status":"healthy"}. nop=0 (stock plan.py returns TODO => pytest 2 failed), oracle=1 (gws-cli docs text recovers 2026-09-15 => pytest 2 passed). No `networks:` block in any task compose (R1.4).

R2.evidence: prod-v1 serves baked corpus mount-free: agent `curl /drive/v3/files` => 28 files with no fixture mount (R2.j). Multi-arch confirmed: `docker buildx imagetools inspect ...:prod-v1` lists linux/amd64 + linux/arm64 (also :latest, :empty). Agent leak-sealed: no /srv/gws.db, no api/ or seed/ source dirs, `python -c 'import gwsclone.seed'` => ModuleNotFoundError, answer 2026-09-15 not greppable in /opt /app /usr/local (R2.k all three checks). Per-task data by mount into gateway only (R2.d); control plane token-gated, operator-only (R2.g).

R3.evidence: Both gws-cli and gws-mcp ship and are thin HTTP clients of one API (no business logic; derived doc-text/search reuse shared store helpers). MCP server lists 11 tools (gws_list_files/get_file/get_document/get_file_text/get_document_text/search_document/list_events/get_event/search_messages/get_message/get_thread). Live parity verified: CLI `docs text` == MCP gws_get_document_text (identical), CLI `calendar events -q LaTeX`==1==MCP gws_list_events, MCP gws_get_file NOPE returns the same 404 error envelope as CLI. Full CLI<->MCP capability parity, no orphan capability.

R4.evidence: No docs/ directory and no docs/COVERAGE.md exist (R4.1 absent) — the required machine-checkable coverage matrix is missing. The underlying surface is faithful (R4.2/R4.3 would pass): envelopes match Google exactly — drive#fileList / calendar#events / {error:{code,message,status}} with 401 UNAUTHENTICATED, 404 NOT_FOUND, 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT all observed live. But R4.1 is gating and the matrix does not exist, so R4 fails.

R5.evidence: R5.1 plausibly met: >=5 read-investigation capabilities carry real query grammar (Drive `q`: name/fullText/mimeType contains/=/!=, 'id' in parents, trashed, and/or/not/parens; Gmail from:/to:/subject:/label: + space-AND/OR/parens; Calendar q + [timeMin,timeMax) window) with realistic 400/404 errors — verified live. BUT R5.2 (>=1 write->read round-trip exercised end-to-end) FAILS: every agent-facing endpoint is GET (the only POSTs are operator-only /_control/*). The clone is read-only; no bundled task does a write->read round-trip. R5.2 is gating => R5 fails.

R6.evidence: Only tests/test_query.py (6 tests, all store-level query-engine unit tests) — passed 6/6 from cold venv. NO HTTP-endpoint tests, NO CLI subprocess tests, NO MCP tool tests, NO CLI<->MCP parity test (R6.2), NO isolation test asserting agent has no seed on disk / `import gwsclone.seed` raises (R6.3). Coverage of the endpoint/CLI/MCP surface is essentially absent. R6.1/R6.2/R6.3 all fail.

R7.evidence: This audit emits audit/audit-report.md + audit/audit-verdict.json with per-requirement results, evidence, and an ordered action list.
